method.frame: npm registry search API (registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search), queries keywords:cli and keywords:command-line, size=250, from=0..5000 step 250 (API caps from at 5000: deeper offsets return page 0). keywords:cli total=113019 but only top 5250 by searchScore reachable; keywords:command-line total 4219, all reachable. Union deduped -> 9198 names. Latest manifest fetched for each (registry.npmjs.org/<name>/latest); kept those whose dependencies include commander or yargs, excluding manifests with deprecated field.
method.popularStratum: 100 names from .sdlc/research/dependents.json top.commander (50) + top.yargs (50) (ecosyste.ms ranking generated 2026-09-23); latest manifests refetched; deprecated excluded.
method.tarballScan: dist.tarball of latest version downloaded (unpackedSize <= 60MB), all .js/.cjs/.mjs/.ts/.jsx/.tsx outside node_modules regex-scanned for require("commander|yargs[/sub]") and import/from/import() of them; bundled-signature regexes for inlined host code.
method.sourceSample: Seeded (20261018) random sample of 160 commander-host + 140 yargs-host (yargs or both) random-stratum packages with a github repository, plus all 98 non-deprecated popular packages with github repo. Shallow blobless sparse clone (package.json, tsconfig*.json, test/spec/__tests__/test(s)/__snapshots__/*.snap), 90s timeout. Package dir located via repository.directory, else package.json name match, else repo root. tsconfig.json nearest to package dir walking up to repo root; relative extends followed; package extends -> unknown unless local module/moduleResolution decides. Effective moduleResolution per TS 5 defaults (module commonjs/unset+target<=ES5 -> node10; module es* -> classic; node16/nodenext; preserve -> bundler).
method.semver: semver@7.6.3 minVersion() on engines.node and host ranges.
